primaryVisitorTask: Choose a suitable round, understand access and reach a real booking or visitor-policy step.
mode: Read with a direct course-choice task path

reconciliation.method: Median rating per criterion, then evidence override: VT4 reduced for homepage booking destinations; VS4 reduced for measured 1.68:1 CTA contrast missed by one reviewer. This is a provisional triage score, not an accepted pass.

evidenceByCriterion.VT1: Golfers and mixed groups are served, but newcomer needs are less direct.
evidenceByCriterion.VT2: First screen promises coastal golf but provides no immediate choose or book action.
evidenceByCriterion.VT3: Corridor and handicap guidance exists; opaque tiers and a claimed ranking do not match displayed order.
evidenceByCriterion.VT4: Course links work, but eight booking links generally land on operator homepages, not a tee-time step.
evidenceByCriterion.FN1: Clear headings but roughly 17,235px main content and 18,795px total page at 390px create heavy mobile scanning.
evidenceByCriterion.FN2: Breadcrumbs and two distinct editorial links work; onward booking is indirect.
evidenceByCriterion.FN3: No course-specific index, filter or jump route for eleven courses.
evidenceByCriterion.ET1: Useful local copy is diluted by repeated superlatives and the unsupported Ranked title.
evidenceByCriterion.ET2: Wind, terrain and non-golfer pairings add grounded local value.
evidenceByCriterion.ET3: Selected National, Portsea and Flinders claims were corrected; full records retain April lastVerified and Flinders contact address needs reconciliation.
evidenceByCriterion.ET4: Independence is explained globally, but volatile access and ranking claims lack adjacent dated primary sources.
evidenceByCriterion.VS1: Ten course photos carry Visit Victoria credits and a rights ledger; a complete all-asset original-grant audit remains open.
evidenceByCriterion.VS2: Strong hero, but repeated text-only cards and mobile fact columns make the page dense.
evidenceByCriterion.VS3: Sora/Figtree hierarchy is coherent; some labels and links are very small on mobile.
evidenceByCriterion.VS4: Measured stay-and-play CTA contrast is 1.68:1 on navy, a serious low-vision barrier despite an otherwise coherent palette.
evidenceByCriterion.VS5: Hero, cards, editorial sections and footer mostly share one visual system.
evidenceByCriterion.MI1: No horizontal overflow at 320/390; narrow comparison value columns and 21-29px links reduce touch usability.
evidenceByCriterion.MI2: Gallery/menu and FAQ work; thumbnails have a weak scroll cue.
evidenceByCriterion.MI3: Consent preferences and gallery recovery were observed; newsletter error paths were not fully tested.
evidenceByCriterion.AT1: Keyboard gallery/menu/FAQ paths partly work; link-list names repeat and direct screen-reader testing is open.
evidenceByCriterion.AT2: A few synthetic loads are not representative field Core Web Vitals.
evidenceByCriterion.AT3: Sampled layouts and reduced-motion state showed no obvious shift; field CLS is unknown.
evidenceByCriterion.AT4: H1, canonical and breadcrumbs exist; Ranked document title conflicts with grouped course content.

hardGates: Stay-and-play CTA text contrast 1.68:1 on navy; low-vision barrier confirmed.
Field Core Web Vitals and CLS for exact route unavailable.
Full-record factual freshness and all-original-grant image rights not independently complete.

triage.boundedAction: Use the existing sand-on-harbour text role and retest >=4.5:1 including focus.

triage.issue: No direct first-screen course decision path, page is exceptionally long on mobile
triage.boundedAction: Add concise choose/jump path and reduce repetitive course copy without hiding essential eligibility.

triage.issue: Ranked title and Tier badges have no visible method; grouping mislabels geographically dispersed courses as Bay corridor
triage.boundedAction: Make title/group labels truthful and either explain tier method or remove tier badges.

triage.issue: Mobile comparison facts and card actions are cramped
triage.boundedAction: Stack definition terms and values on narrow screens, use contextual link names and 44px touch targets.

triage.issue: Booking routes and volatile claims lack direct source/date context
triage.boundedAction: Audit official tee-time and visitor-policy destinations and add adjacent dated source links in a separate factual pass.

impeccable.assessmentB: Independent detector and browser assessment completed: two low-severity style warnings; mobile CTA measured at 1.68:1, 21px course action target, no sampled overflow or JS errors.

impeccable.question: Questions skipped: James has already approved continuous score-triage-execute iteration.
